name: Infector
body:
The disease inside you have gained supernatural potency.

Prerequisite(s): Sanguinai, Bloodsucker, Disease Carrier, Con 17

Benefit(s): People failing their save against malaria from your bite or blood drain contract it immediately (the onset period does not apply). This tall ophidian has beautiful, glistening scales and exudes an imperious aura, though monstrous muscles coiling under its thick skin betray him as a deadly combatant.
